about_the_game:
Experience the first 4 days of this thrilling rivalry in the demo! Unlock all 14 days of drama, strategy, and romance in the full version.

Compete with Your Rival

Meet Richard, Justin's charismatic and cunning rival. As the head of a major corporation, Richard is wealthy, confident, and dangerously charming. His good looks and sharp style make him a magnet for women, but his arrogance is his Achilles' heel. On this trip, Richard is set on outshining Justin, seducing Justin's wife Tracy and their nanny Lisa, and making Justin look like a fool—all while hiding his own flaws.

Justin, armed with his physical prowess and quick wit, must outmaneuver Richard’s schemes. It’s a high-stakes battle of egos where every move counts. Highlight Richard’s weaknesses, showcase Justin’s strengths, and claim victory in this clash of charm and cunning. It’s not about being perfect—it’s about being the better man.

Gameplay

In this demo, dive into the first 4 days of an emotionally charged story, with the full version expanding to 14 days of intense rivalry. Forget stat-grinding—Justin's skills are already honed. Instead, focus on navigating relationships, outsmarting Richard, and making pivotal choices that shape the story.

Visit key locations at the right moments, engage with dynamic characters, and make decisions that drive the narrative. The gameplay is fast-paced, emotionally gripping, and designed for replayability, with new scenes and outcomes to uncover in every playthrough. Immerse yourself in a twisted tale of competition and consequence, where every choice brings you closer to triumph.

Play the demo now and experience the first 4 days. Get the full version to unlock all 14 days and dominate the ultimate rivalry!

content_descriptors.notes: This game is dedicated to the adult audience only - we present vivid sex scenes without any censorship. In some cases, characters perform "vanilla sex", but sometimes we present more kinky scenes, including cheating on your partner, lesbian sex, threesomes or foursomes, sex for money or position, the elements of BDSM and more bizarre scenes.
